english.title: Encourage / assist in commission of indictable offences believing one / more will be committed
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..), which was capable of encouraging or assisting the commission of one or more of a number of indictable offences, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INDICTABLE OFFENCE(S)..), believing that one or more of those offences would be committed and that your act would encourage or assist the commission of one or more of them
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 46 and 58 of the Serious Crime Act 2007.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See also section 47 of the Serious Crime Act 2007 re points to be considered in proving this offence.
(ii) Section 55 of the Serious Crime Act 2007 provides that the offence is triable in the same way as the anticipated offence.
(iii) Issues of extra-territoriality: see section 52 of the Act for details of jurisdiction; section 53 provides that no proceedings for an offence triable by reason of any provision of Schedule 4 may be instituted without the consent of the Attorney General (issues of extra-territoriality).
(iv) See section 54 of the Act for details relating to the institution of proceedings.
(v) MoPI Group 2 has been allocated to ensure manual review. The MoPI group of the substantive offence applies.

other.penalty:
Indictable only: if one or more of the either way offences is punishable with imprisonment, liability is to imprisonment for a term not exceeding the maximum term provided for any one of those offences (taking the longer or the longest term as the limit for the purposes of this paragraph where the terms provided differ); or to a fine, see section 58.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
